A little note for you.

Dear Afreen, Today is your day. ♡ I hope your 17th birthday is full of happiness, good moments, lots of laughs, and people who make you smile. I hope this year brings you many good things and gives you a lot of memories that you’ll always remember. And honestly, I just hope you stay the same person you are — kind, funny, a little stubborn, and sometimes completely crazy. Don’t change yourself just to fit in with others. Be yourself, always. Happy 17th Birthday, Afreen. ❤️ I hope you have an amazing year ahead and get everything you wish for. — with a lot of love & a suspicious amount of pink ♡ ♡
